mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_post (user_id, board_id, title, content, view_count, reply_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCount}, #{replyCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, p.content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_post WHERE board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 180) AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, b.name AS boardName FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON b.id = p.board_id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, p.content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, b.name AS boardName FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON b.id = p.board_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_post SET reply_count = reply_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 180) AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, b.name AS boardName FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON p.board_id = b.id WHERE p.title LIKE #{keyword} OR p.content LIKE #{keyword} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 180) AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, b.name AS boardName FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON p.board_id = b.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
